portfolio_rationale: The portfolio tilts away from SPY's market-cap growth exposure after weak breadth and recent Nasdaq underperformance, while selecting only candidates with base forecasts above SPY. rationale_summary: Base case expects short-lived continuation of value, defensive, rate-sensitive, and energy leadership over the one-week window. The main edge versus SPY is avoiding recently weak technology-heavy exposure while using supplied catalysts such as the July 22 petroleum report and softer inflation data.
